upwork_title: Getting paid from Upwork, country by country
upwork_desc: Upwork is open to freelancers in {n} of {total} UN member states. See whether it's open in yours and how you can receive the money, with sources.
upwork_intro: Upwork is open to freelancers in {n} of {total} countries. Upwork doesn't publish which withdrawal methods each country gets: they show in your account. So next to each country we show which of the main receiving services work there.
upwork_caption: Countries where Upwork is open, with the receiving services that work there
upwork_reason_open: Not on Upwork's list of restricted countries.
upwork_reason_closed: On Upwork's list of restricted countries.
upwork_source_note: Upwork also excludes Crimea, the so-called DPR and LPR, individual Cuban nationals, sanctioned persons and other places "restricted by law". Receiving-service statuses come from each country page.
about_intro: Every line links to where it came from. If we can't find a reliable source, we say so instead of guessing.
about_works: The service's own list, or a reliable source, confirms it for your country.
about_likely: The service says it covers almost every country, but nothing confirms yours by name.
about_limited: It works with conditions, like a partner bank or a registered business.
about_unconfirmed: The service operates there, but we couldn't confirm you can get paid.
about_no: The service doesn't serve your country.
about_sources: Service pages, government sites, central banks and tax offices first. Guides and news only when official pages say nothing, and then the line says it rests on one source.
about_rule: For clients paying you, we name the first that works in this order: PayPal, Payoneer, Wise. For selling online: Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Payhip, Polar, Paddle, Stripe. Same rule for every country.
about_legit: We never suggest borrowed accounts, foreign addresses or VPN tricks. They break the services' rules, get money frozen and can break the law.
about_privacy_views_b: No cookies, no ad trackers, no IP addresses kept.
about_privacy_views: We count page views by page and by visitor country (the country comes from the network, not from you), so we know which pages people need. That's all we record about visits.
about_privacy_alerts: If you sign up, we keep your email address and the countries you picked, only to email you when those pages change. We never share or sell it. To stop, use the unsubscribe link in any email, or the form below.
unsubscribe_note: Removes your address and all your countries.
about_translation: Pages in other languages are translated from the English pages. Numbers, rates, dates, official names and service names are checked automatically against the English. The long research details and the sources stay in English. If a translation and the English page differ, the English page is the reference.
about_logos: Logos belong to their companies and are shown only to say which service a line is about. We're not affiliated with any of them, and nobody pays to be listed. Logo files come from Simple Icons and Polar's own site. Type is Newsreader, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next and Noto, all under the SIL Open Font License, served from this site.
